subject: integration
name: Names standard (NAMES_0_2)
summary: A definition of NAMES_0_2: resolve as in NAMES_0_1, plus a manage group (risk 8) with setRecord, which asks to point a name's contenthash at an ipfs://, ipns:// or bzz:// address. The definition says the person confirms each change in the wallet's own sheet and the site never sees a key or signature; it cannot make a resolver do so. A resolver sees the names asked, and its proven flag is its own word. The row names no resolver and holds no key, code or address. Level 4 with privacy as a definition. Judged here by its publisher.
